description: Private ordinary-assertion probes for the active Arachne wall configuration, transition placement, and resolution paths; native validation is pending.

mutants.description: Use the wrong percent-to-nozzle conversion for transition length; the mapping case's independent 250% -> 1.0 mm oracle must fail as an ordinary assertion.
Drop the active transition length in SkeletalTrapezoidation; the scaled plus fixture requires the 100% and 300% rows to produce distinct transition geometry.
Discard the active distribution radius at WallToolPaths generation; the scaled plus fixture requires the count-1 and count-3 width signatures to differ while preserving the footprint and length.
Ignore the configured maximum resolution during outline preparation; the rounded 256-vertex fixture requires fine resolution to retain more junctions than the coarse resolution control.
